description: Project-specific configuration for this instance of the process framework. Update this file when adapting framework to a new project.

project.name: LinkWatcher
project.description: Real-time link maintenance system using file system watching

paths.description: Project-specific directory paths relative to root or absolute

testing.description: Test runner configuration — language-specific commands are in process-framework/languages-config/{language}/{language}-config.json

documentation_map.description: Per-project opt-outs for the Source Code Documentation Map (Build-DocumentationMap.ps1 -Tree SC, PF-IMP-1955). src_exclude_dirs: directory NAMES (matched at any depth under paths.source_code) excluded from indexing, in addition to the framework-wide invariants (archive/old and dependency/build caches, pruned in-script). src_extra_extensions: extensions (with dot) indexed beyond the default set - e.g. '.json', which is deliberately not indexed by default. Absent block or empty arrays = defaults; no configuration is required for the SC map to work.

integration.description: Integration with project-specific tools and systems

recommended_skills.description: Claude Code skills recommended for specific tasks in this project. Each key is a task slug (task definition filename without .md); value is an array of skill objects. Language-bound skills go in languages-config instead. Populated during Project Initiation (PF-TSK-059 Step 10).

layering_rules.description: Per-project layer dependency rules. Source of truth for layer-boundary checks at PF-TSK-032 Code Quality Standards Validation. Narrative companion: the source-layout craft skill (.claude/skills/source-layout/SKILL.md, Layer Dependency Rules); usage: process-framework/guides/05-validation/feature-validation-guide.md (Layer-Boundary Validation). Empty 'layers' = no enforcement (backward-compatible default). Populate during PF-TSK-064/066 onboarding or after ADRs codify layer-boundary invariants.

_layer_schema_example._comment: Reference schema for a populated layer entry. Remove the leading underscore on the key when adopting. 'name' is the layer's identifier referenced by 'may_import_from' in other layers; 'directory_glob' identifies source files belonging to this layer; 'may_import_from' is the allowlist (importing from a layer not listed here is a finding).
_layer_schema_example.name: ui

cross_feature_isolation.description: If true, services in one feature may not import non-service layers from another feature directly. Forces service-to-service composition across feature boundaries. Independent of 'layers' — can be enabled separately.
